bio: I'm Raj Revannuru, a Documentation Solutions Architect based in Hyderabad, India. I help organizations turn complex products and engineering workflows into clear, useful experiences for customers and internal teams.

My work spans documentation strategy, content architecture, knowledge management, and Docs-as-Code. Across cloud platforms, APIs, enterprise software, hardware, and telecommunications, I build scalable documentation systems that make information easier to find, understand, and maintain.
I bring together structured content, thoughtful information architecture, and practical workflows to help people get more value from products.

values.title: Clarity over cleverness
values.text: We write to be understood, not to impress. If a simpler word works, we use it.

values.title: Partnership, not just delivery
values.text: We work with your team, not around them. The best docs come from the people who know the product.

values.title: Honest about scope
values.text: We tell you what will help most, what won't, and what it will take. No overselling, no surprises.

story: VAKS Consulting was founded on a simple observation: most documentation is an afterthought. It's written in a hurry, by people who know too much to explain it clearly, for users who are left to figure it out alone.

We started VAKS Consulting to change that. We bring the same rigour and craft to documentation that great teams bring to their products: structured thinking, clear language, and a genuine obsession with the reader's experience.
We take on a small number of projects at a time, so every client works directly with a senior documentation architect. Today we work with startups and technology companies across India and beyond.

homeFaq.a: Every project starts with a free scoping call. We then send a fixed proposal tailored to your needs.

homeFaq.q: How long does a typical project take?
homeFaq.a: Most projects run between 4 and 12 weeks, depending on scope. An audit can take as little as 2 weeks; a full help centre or API reference takes longer. We agree the timeline before we start.
Yes. We're happy to sign your NDA before we see any product details or internal material.

homeFaq.q: Which tools and formats do you work in?
homeFaq.a: We deliver in Markdown, HTML, PDF or your CMS, and work in tools such as Confluence, Notion, Google Docs, Git and docs-as-code platforms. If your team already uses a tool, we work in it.

homeFaq.q: Do you work with teams outside India?
homeFaq.a: Yes. We're based in Hyderabad and work remotely with teams worldwide, with call times that overlap your working day.

testimonials.quote: Some of our internal process documents were incomplete or out of date, making it difficult for employees to follow the right procedures. VAKS Consulting helped us improve and clarify those processes in line with our policies and work ethics. They also supported us in creating professional marketing content and clear, useful Statements of Purpose for our customers. Their work has helped us communicate more consistently and support our customers more effectively.

Our product information was scattered across different sources and depended heavily on a few key people. The documentation specialist brought it together by gathering technical information and interviewing our subject matter experts. They created installation and user guides from scratch, making deployment clearer and helping customers get up to speed more easily. As a result, we reduced deployment time and improved the onboarding experience.

testimonials.quote: Our cloud-based application had complex, role-based access, with different screens and tasks for each user type, but its documentation was incomplete.
